summary: Warroad International Memorial Airport (RRT) is a small general aviation airport serving the community of Warroad in far northern Minnesota, near the Canadian border and the southern shore of Lake of the Woods. The 'International' designation in its name reflects the town's close proximity to Manitoba, Canada, just across the lake. The airport primarily supports recreational flying, local business travel, and serves the region's popular fishing and outdoor tourism industry.
faqs:
Q: What airlines fly into Warroad International Memorial Airport?
A: RRT does not have scheduled commercial airline service and operates primarily as a general aviation facility. Most visitors reach Warroad by driving or through larger nearby airports.

Q: Where exactly is Warroad located?
A: Warroad is in Roseau County in extreme northern Minnesota, about 10 miles south of the Canadian border along the shores of Lake of the Woods.

Q: Does the airport have any commercial flights or charter services?
A: No scheduled commercial flights operate from RRT, though charter and private flights can be arranged. The nearest airport with commercial service is Thief River Falls Regional Airport (TVF), roughly 90 miles to the south.

Q: What is Warroad best known for?
A: Warroad is famously known as 'Hockey Town USA,' producing numerous NHL players and boasting one of the most storied high school hockey programs in the country.
transport_tips: Renting a car is the most practical option for getting to and from RRT, as there is no public transit serving the airport. The airport is located just a few miles east of downtown Warroad along Minnesota State Highway 11, making taxi or pre-arranged shuttle services relatively quick. Travelers flying privately should coordinate fuel and ground handling in advance, as on-site services are limited.
local_tip: If visiting Warroad, plan time to explore Lake of the Woods—one of the largest freshwater lakes in North America and a premier walleye and sturgeon fishing destination. The local bait shops and fishing guides can set you up with an unforgettable experience just minutes from the airport.
